stock_uncle_insight.date_header: 8/20 法人與主力大戶主要買超股票

buyer_groups.group_title: 1. 外資大戶：航運、電信與部分傳產的避風港

stocks.description: 肖年仔，外資狂掃陽明3.11萬張，這波海運是不是又要再起風了？大戶資金往傳產跑，這不是巧合，是嗅到什麼味道了。
電信股這種防禦型標的，外資抱緊處理1.86萬張，顯然是想找個避風港，市場震盪時，穩定配息的才是王道。
食品龍頭統一，外資也買了1.32萬張，穩定獲利、民生必需，這種股票就是大戶壓艙底的貨，跌也跌不到哪去。
金融股外資有買有賣，兆豐金被青睞1.20萬張，可能是看好其穩健體質，但肖年仔，別忘了外資也在倒其他金融股，這叫兩面手法。
跟陽明一樣，航運雙雄都被外資點名，長榮也買了0.85萬張，這不是巧合，是資金在移動，肖年仔，船票要不要上？
外資買聯電0.78萬張，但投信跟自營商卻在倒貨，這檔主力看法分歧，肖年仔別黑白猜，這種股票風險高。

buyer_groups.group_title: 2. 投信大戶（本土國家隊）：金融股作帳行情啟動

stocks.description: 投信狂掃玉山金2.47萬張，跟外資對作，這擺明是作帳行情，肖年仔，看好這波年底結帳，金融股要被拉抬淨值了。
投信大買台新新光金2.18萬張，跟外資對作，這就是本土國家隊的實力，要拉抬淨值了，肖年仔，跟著國家隊走準沒錯。
投信連合庫金這種官股金控都買了1.18萬張，穩健型標的被鎖碼，這波金融股的買盤很全面，不是單一事件。
投信持續加碼永豐金0.83萬張，這波金融股有戲，肖年仔，別只看電子股，傳產金融也是有機會的。
投信買凱基金0.79萬張，這波金融股的買盤很全面，從大型金控到中型金控，都有國家隊的影子。

buyer_groups.group_title: 3. 內資主力與實戶：短線避險與中小型電子點火

stocks.description: 自營商買神達0.22萬張，這檔中小型電子股，是不是有什麼題材要點火？肖年仔，這種股票通常是短線主力在玩，小心追高。
自營商買仁寶0.13萬張，但外資卻在賣，這就是短線避險盤在玩，肖年仔，別看單一法人動作，要看整體籌碼。
自營商也買智原0.09萬張，這類IC設計股，通常是題材發酵時會被點火，但自營商的量不大，可能是短線操作。
自營商小買台積電0.03萬張，這種權值股，自營商通常是做避險或短線價差，肖年仔，別以為自營商買台積電就是看好大盤。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略一：高檔避險與資金避風港（金融、電信、傳產）
strategies.strategy_content: 肖年仔，你看外資大買航運、電信、食品、金融，這些都是相對穩健或有旺季題材的傳產股。同時，外資大賣0050、電子權值股和部分金融股，這很明顯是資金從高風險板塊撤出，轉往具有防禦性或穩定配息的標的。市場震盪時，大戶會找地方躲，金融、電信就是最好的避風港。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略二：投信作帳與結帳（電子轉金融）
strategies.strategy_content: 本土國家隊投信，狂掃金融股，玉山金、台新新光金、合庫金、永豐金、凱基金，買超榜上清一色都是金融。同時，他們大賣聯電、華邦電等電子股。這就是典型的季底或月底作帳行情，把資金從漲多的電子股抽出來，灌進相對低基期或有殖利率題材的金融股，拉抬基金淨值。肖年仔，跟著投信作帳，有肉吃！

strategies.strategy_title: 策略三：短線主力與避險盤（中小型電子、權值股調節）
strategies.strategy_content: 自營商買進神達、仁寶、智原等中小型電子股，但同時也賣出0050、聯電、群創等權值股和面板股。這顯示自營商的避險盤或短線操作，一方面調節大盤權值股降低風險，另一方面則點火一些有題材的中小型電子股，賺取短線價差。肖年仔，自營商的單子，通常隔日沖的機率很高，別傻傻去追高。

stock_uncle_insight.summary: 肖年仔，今天三大法人動作很明顯，外資避險轉進傳產與防禦股，投信狂掃金融作帳，自營商則在電子股玩短線。總之，市場資金正在大挪移，別黑白買，看清楚主力動向，才能不被割韭菜！

top_brokerages_analysis.uncle_logic: 高盛這種外資大咖買航運陽明1.09萬張，這不是長線布局就是看好波段，肖年仔，這船票要不要上？大戶出手，必有其因。
凱基台北這種隔日沖大戶買神達0.088萬張，明天開盤小心倒貨，別傻傻去接刀，這種分點就是來割韭菜的。
元大投信是本土國家隊，大買玉山金1.11萬張，這就是作帳的訊號，肖年仔，金融股年底有行情，跟著國家隊吃豆腐。
摩根大通這種外資大咖倒貨群創1.83萬張，這面板股短期內恐怕難翻身，肖年仔，小心為上，別去接這種掉下來的刀。

english_professor_news.title: Costco launching Medicare Advantage plans with SCAN Group
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Costco Wholesale Corporation and nonprofit insurer SCAN Group announced a partnership on Tuesday to sell Costco-branded Medicare plans, marking the retailer's first entry into the Medicare market. The two companies plan to begin with Medicare Advantage products in two states and a Medicare supplement plan in a third, pending regulatory approval from the Medicare agency, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Under the arrangement, Costco would market branded health insurance products for older adults; the companies said covered services could encompass prescription drug access, Medflex over-the-counter benefits, vision care, and audiology, among other offerings. The plans will be sold in Costco stores as well as through insurance agents and other standard channels. Federal rules prohibit bundling a Costco membership with the health plans.

SCAN Group CEO Dr. Sachin H. Jain said the new Medicare Advantage plans would integrate closely with Costco's existing offerings across prescription drugs, vision, over-the-counter medications, food, and hearing products. \
english_professor_news.level2_context: 美國大型超市連鎖店Costco與非營利醫療保險公司SCAN Group合作推出Costco-branded Medicare Advantage plans，進入美國老年人醫療保險市場。這項合作將使Costco能夠提供更全面的醫療保健服務，包括藥物保險、藥品無需門診就能購買、視力保險、聽力保險等。這項合作將對於Costco和SCAN Group的經營帶來新的機會，同時也能夠改善老年人醫療保險的服務質量。

level3_translation.sentence: Costco Wholesale Corporation and nonprofit insurer SCAN Group announced a partnership on Tuesday to sell Costco-branded Medicare plans, marking the retailer's first entry into the Medicare market.
level3_translation.translation: Costco Wholesale Corporation和非營利醫療保險公司SCAN Group宣布合作推出Costco-branded Medicare plans， marking the retailer's first entry into the Medicare market.

level3_translation.sentence: The two companies plan to begin with Medicare Advantage products in two states and a Medicare supplement plan in a third, pending regulatory approval from the Medicare agency, according to the Wall Street Journal.
level3_translation.translation: 兩家公司計畫開始推出 Medicare Advantage 產品在兩個州和一州的 Medicare 补充保險，pending regulatory approval from the Medicare agency, according to the Wall Street Journal.

level3_translation.sentence: Under the arrangement, Costco would market branded health insurance products for older adults; the companies said covered services could encompass prescription drug access, Medflex over-the-counter benefits, vision care, and audiology, among other offerings.
level3_translation.translation: 根據協議，Costco將推出 branded health insurance products for older adults；公司表示 COVERED 服務包括藥物保險、Medflex over-the-counter benefits、視力保險和聽力保險等。

level3_translation.sentence: The plans will be sold in Costco stores as well as through insurance agents and other standard channels.
level3_translation.translation: 這些計畫將在Costco商店中出售，也將通過保險代理人和其他標準的通路出售。

level3_translation.sentence: Federal rules prohibit bundling a Costco membership with the health plans.
level3_translation.translation: 聯邦規定禁止將Costco會員身份與健康計畫 bundling.

level3_translation.sentence: SCAN Group CEO Dr. Sachin H. Jain said the new Medicare Advantage plans would integrate closely with Costco's existing offerings across prescription drugs, vision, over-the-counter medications, food, and hearing products.
level3_translation.translation: SCAN Group CEO Dr. Sachin H. Jain 表示新的 Medicare Advantage 計畫將與Costco 的現有的藥品、視力、無 prescription藥品、食品和聽力產品整合非常緊密.

level3_translation.sentence: "We are trying to create something that's incredibly simple for people to use that will enable them to seamlessly access their benefits," Dr. Jain said.
level3_translation.translation: "我們試圖創建一個非常簡單的工具，讓人們能夠輕易地使用，從而能夠無縫地獲得其優勢," Dr. Jain 表示.

level3_translation.sentence: Costco CEO Ron Vachris said in a statement that the partnership extends the retailer's longstanding commitment to delivering value to its members.
level3_translation.translation: Costco CEO Ron Vachris 在一份 statement 中表示，這項合作延伸了商店對其會員的長期承諾，提供價值.

level3_translation.sentence: "We have developed a shared understanding of what matters most to the seniors we serve," Vachris said in the statement.
level3_translation.translation: "我們已經發展了一個共同的理解，了解老年人我們為他們所提供的最重要的東西," Vachris 在 statement 中表示.

level3_translation.sentence: "Deepening our partnership allows us to build on that foundation and create value for our members," Vachris said.
level3_translation.translation: "我們的合作深化了我們的基礎，從而能夠為我們的會員創建價值," Vachris 表示.

level3_translation.sentence: Richard Stephens, senior vice president for pharmacy at Costco, described the Medicare effort as a pilot.
level3_translation.translation: Costco藥房總裁Richard Stephens 表示，這項 Medicare 專案是一個試驗.

level3_translation.sentence: "We plan to learn a lot from it, and we plan to make sure that we have the right product for our members," Stephens told the Wall Street Journal.
level3_translation.translation: "我們打算從這個試驗中學習很多，同時也要確保我們為會員提供適合的產品," Stephens 在 Wall Street Journal 中表示.

level3_translation.sentence: He added that Costco members trust that the retailer has vetted what it sells, and that the company aims to apply that same standard to the new insurance product.
level3_translation.translation: 他還表示，Costco 的會員信任商店已經檢查了它所售出的產品，而公司打算將這個標準應用到新的保險產品上.

level3_translation.sentence: SCAN Health Plan's coverage footprint spans 33 counties across six states — California, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, New Mexico, and Washington — reaching close to 460,000 members.
level3_translation.translation: SCAN Health Plan 的覆蓋範圍遍及六個州的 33 個縣，包括加州、阿里ゾ納、內華達、德克薩斯、新墨西哥和華盛頓州，覆蓋近 460,000 名會員.

level3_translation.sentence: When affiliated programs and entities are included, the broader SCAN Group network reaches roughly 500,000 members and patients, the company said.
level3_translation.translation: 當聯合的計畫和單位被包含在內，SCAN Group 的更廣泛的網絡覆蓋了大約 500,000 名會員和患者，公司表示.

level3_translation.sentence: The two companies declined to disclose the financial terms of the partnership.
level3_translation.translation: 兩家公司拒絕透露合作伙伴關係的財務條件.

english_professor_news.title: Citigroup To Launch Bitcoin Custody For Institutional Clients
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Leading U.S. commercial bank Citigroup (NYSE: $C) says it plans to offer Bitcoin (CRYPTO: $BTC) custody to its institutional clients by year's end.

The move by Citigroup will bring crypto into the same infrastructure the bank uses to safeguard traditional assets for institutional investors that include pensions and hedge funds.

Crypto custody is the secure storage and management of the private cryptographic keys required to access, own, and transfer digital assets on a blockchain.

MEXC July TradFi Trading Shifts Toward AI Storage as SNDK Futures Volume Surges More Than 15x Times

MEXC's August 2026 Proof of Reserves Confirms User Assets Fully Backed as Reserve Ratios Remain Above 100%

News of the crypto custody service comes as Citigroup introduced "Custody+," a suite of services designed to make custody, settlement, foreign exchange and cash management faster.

The service, which does not yet have a set launch date, will start with Bitcoin and provide clients access to traditional and crypto custody through the same framework.

Citigroup's custody operation currently serves clients in more than 100 markets, including 62 markets where it runs its own custody network.
